title: Treasury
paragraphs: “Yeah, it’s worth a try.”

“Yeah, but… with the traces of destruction on that monument and now finding these legendary weapons, things are getting even more suspicious… Why would so many of these be hidden in a place like this? Whoa, this one seems to contain an amazing skill.”

Ren muttered as he picked up a luxuriously decorated sword that had been carelessly discarded. I also picked up one to check. The basic specs of these weapons are way beyond the spears I’ve found so far.
Oh… Magic Lance Rune, Gáe Dearg, and even Gigantic Lance, a spear that grants a bonus ability when a certain attack power is reached.
Even just the ones lying around here seem quite powerful, don’t they? The skills they contain are equally formidable. …Well, there are some duplicates too.
“This is incredible. These weapons’ base stats are way higher than anything we’ve used before.”
“If we enhance these further, who knows what they’ll become… There are even guns lying around here.”
As for Itsuki… is that a rifle? Or a crossbow? He picked up one of the strange and hard-to-identify weapons, possibly a handgun, and spoke.
“Handgun Ludger… There should be a brother gun, a handgun called Moira. Can you help me look for it?”
“Is there something special about it?”

“In the game era, it was said to be the ultimate rare weapon. When you paired the two together, they merged into one and made even the toughest bosses a breeze. The drop rate was so low that anyone who had them was accused of using cheats. Guns usually can’t be the strongest, but this one was an exception. Well, that was in the game… Oh, I found Artemis! This is another extremely rare one!”
Itsuki was completely absorbed in searching. It was a machine-gun talk. His eyes were sparkling. Ren was the same.
“Ah, there’s some fancy sword stuck in a pedestal. Could this be… the legendary holy sword or something?”
Oh, indeed. It’s stuck in a pedestal. It looks just like the swords that kings or heroes pull out in classic fantasy stories.
However… the way it’s just sitting there, like someone ripped out the entire pedestal along with the legendary weapon, is downright crude.
“It looks like someone tore out the whole pedestal and brought it here.”
“Yeah… no sense of elegance at all. Who would do something like this?”
Ren casually tried to pull out the sword, but it wouldn’t budge.

That means you’re not the chosen one! However, the copy seemed to have activated, and the sword transformed. When he swung it, a gust of wind was released. It seems to be a sword that commands the wind.
“This is amazing.”
“It’s an incredible treasure vault… I still can’t find Moira. Gaelion, let’s search somewhere else.”
“Leave it to me!”
“Wait, wait. Exploring is fine, but we need to investigate properly.”
“I know, I know. Father, did you find any good shields?”

Father… when I looked over, he was holding an incredibly luxurious shield. The shield that Father used in the first world was quite powerful, but even at a glance, I could tell that this one was just as good.
“Uh… Aegis and… Aigis… Oh, there’s even something like a Shield of Light. There’s a strong set of elemental shields too. As for the skill… Defense Link?”
When Father spoke the skill name, something like a band of light extended from him and connected to us.
What kind of effect is this?
“I don’t know what effect it has yet… but it’s worth testing out.”
“Indeed. I expect it to be something useful.”
“But… most of these weapons can only be used because they can be copied. It doesn’t look like there’s anything Kuro and the others can use.”
“The blades seem to have been dulled. You can really sense the intention to destroy them. Also, magical protection, curses, or something similar seem to be weakening the weapons.”
“About that… Ren, can I ask you something?”
“What is it?”
Father transformed his shield into something that looked like a cluster of scabbards. It’s quite an unusual design. It’s more like a stone-built sheath full of holes than a shield.
“This is called the Whetstone Shield, and its special effect is automatic sharpening. If we insert the weapons into this…”
“I see! It might restore them to usable condition!”
Ren immediately started inserting multiple swords into Father’s shield.
It looked just like that party game where you stick swords into a barrel and hope it doesn’t pop!
“Normally, the regular Whetstone Shield takes about 8 hours. But if it’s the awakened version, the Supreme Whetstone Shield, it can reduce the time to 3 hours.”
We all started inserting the usable weapons we found into the shield Father had shown us. Since claws are Filolial-sama’s preferred weapon, we focused on those.
“Does anyone else have any whetstone-type weapons?”
“Unfortunately… my exclusive effect is different.”
“I guess that’s unavoidable for Itsuki.”

Well, he uses bows and guns. It’s hard to imagine how those would even be sharpened. I tried to recall and searched for a whetstone spear. Found it. However, like Itsuki, my effect was also different.
“My weapon…”
Ren’s weapon changed into something that resembled a sheath. It looked like it could be folded in half, with a hidden mechanism inside.
“It works, but it seems like I can only insert one weapon. Probably just one at a time.”
“Well, it’s for sharpening after all…”
“By the way, what kind of effects do Itsuki and Motoyasu have?”
“In my case, it seems to generate sharp arrows when performing certain actions.”
“In my case, evasive movements seem to apply an attack boost.”
It’s nothing to scoff at, but I don’t think there’s a need to constantly switch weapons. If this were back when we first came to this world, it might have been a different story.
“Well… it can’t be helped.”
“So, what do we do? Since there are so many weapons here, shouldn’t we consider switching them out as needed?”
“Switching to superior weapons is fine, but do we have the ores and materials needed to enhance them?”
We all checked together.

Indeed… if you ask whether we have enough to enhance all these weapons, it’s doubtful. The better the weapon, the rarer the ores and materials needed for its enhancement… excessive enhancement is out of the question. Moreover, awakening the enhancement method Ren taught us consumes an absurd amount of proficiency points.
“It’s a difficult balance.”
“It burns through resources like crazy. But these weapons are strong enough to justify that.”
“But isn’t it risky to decide which weapon to enhance just based on what’s lying around here?”
“…True. If we find a better weapon later and can’t enhance it due to a lack of materials, we’d be stuck.”
“Maybe we should hold off until we encounter something that looks like a boss.”
“Or it might be a good idea to search the treasure vault for any enhancement materials.”
“Agreed!”

It seems there are many powerful weapons scattered around here. It reminded me of the Emerald Online days, where even low-level weapons could become useful with proper enhancements if you specialized your stats. Compared to the weapons we found here, the difference in strength is unknown, but testing their enhancement potential shows how different they are.
“Amazing…”
Big sister murmured as she looked around the treasure vault.
“So shiny!”
Even Filolial-sama was delighted by the sight of all the shiny objects.
“As for staves… oh, but I don’t see any armor.”
“We can search for that next.”
“Right. If we can get a good staff, it might be a boost for Raphtalia, right?”
“It looks like they’re malfunctioning due to quality degradation.”

Even though they’re indestructible, their quality has deteriorated over time. Father is trying to restore them through sharpening, but it seems staves aren’t his specialty. At that moment, Itsuki raised his hand.
